features.name: Kareth
known_facts: Current base settlement
Sits on an open shelf / natural terrace, not a tight valley or basin
The former new front defensive line is now a substantial outer wall; the old wall remains as an inner defensive line
Kareth has exactly two gates: the front/main gate and the back/quarry gate
The front gate serves Avelin and most outward regional travel
The back gate serves the quarry and haul road

features.name: Kareth Quarry
known_facts: Cut within broader stony upland / broken higher ground
Going up toward the quarry is slower; returning toward Kareth is faster
Quarry is viable and active
Heavy blocks are stockpiled
The Kareth–Quarry route is a regularly used worked haul road with major hazards reduced and drainage improved
Dark low-bodied creature threat was unresolved before Mårék's 337-day absence; current status has not yet been checked

features.name: Avelin
known_facts: Avelin relocated to the former cairn-marked candidate site during Mårék's 337-day absence
Avelin remains a separate settlement with its own wall, people, leadership, fields, and livestock
Kareth and Avelin are close neighbors rather than one merged settlement
The groundwater seep has been developed into a proper stone-edged collection point
The Kareth–Avelin alliance held through the absence
A maintained road connects Kareth's front gate with Avelin

features.name: Valek road split
known_facts: Before Saddle Ridge, the road to Valek splits from the northeast main road
The Valek road turns north from the split
Exact location along the road remains schematic
No additional proper right-hand road branch was observed here from the Kareth-facing approach
No readable informational signpost was observed here

features.name: Saddle Ridge
known_facts: Avelin now lies on the Kareth-facing side of the broader Saddle Ridge corridor
Rolling hills build gradually toward Saddle Ridge
The old Avelin site lies farther along the established road beyond the ridge corridor

features.name: Old Avelin Site
known_facts: Former/original Avelin settlement site beyond Saddle Ridge
Old wall remains in substantial sections
House and structure shapes remain
No obvious bustle or visible roof smoke was seen from the road during Mårék's visit
Some building materials have been removed from parts of the site
The site has not been flattened
The old road runs into the former settlement
Current occupancy, ownership, and exact use remain unresolved

features.name: Low Ridge
known_facts: First established landmark on the Kareth–Valek route
No carved roadside marker exists here

features.name: Stone-bottomed Stream Crossing
known_facts: Shallow, firm stone-bottomed crossing
Traveler-use signs established
Broad shade trees downstream established
Far bank has a small natural runoff channel a few feet across at widest
Runoff channel showed little/no flow during the recent visit, with erosion, darker staining and washed gravel from prior stronger water
No clear foot trail, wagon marks, worked stone, marker, or structure was observed in the runoff channel

features.name: Valek

travel.time: ~7 hours to Kareth at established pace

known_facts: Established substantial road town
Reached by the road that branches north before Saddle Ridge
Exact direct compass bearing from Kareth remains unresolved
Busy stable yard, active tavern and market observed
An internal town street junction was observed but is not established as a regional outbound route split
No additional proper crossroads or readable directional road signs were observed on Mårék's current Kareth-to-Valek ride

features.name: Meren Junction
known_facts: First proper regional road junction observed west of Valek
Main traveled road continues west toward Dāren Ford
A narrower but proper road branches northwest toward Meren
Weathered wooden signpost with two carved destination boards
Boards identify Dāren Ford on the main road and Meren on the northwest branch
No distances were carved on the boards

features.name: Hareth Rest

travel.time: ~2 to 2.5 hours from Valek including the Meren junction approach

known_facts: Small inhabited roadside stop, explicitly described by a local as not really a village
Handful of buildings, fenced pen, covered lean-to, wagons, and a small roadside shelter or drinking place
Food, water, and rest available
No wall or gate observed
Locals described the west road ahead as good that morning

features.name: West Road Stone Bridge

travel.time: ~1.5 hours beyond Hareth Rest at the observed pace

known_facts: Stone bridge crosses a narrow river or large stream
A three-wagon westbound group was stopped on the near side with a damaged wheel during Mårék's passage
A separate smaller wagon was found pulled off the road beyond the bridge with no animal hitched
The abandoned wagon showed signs of a hard sideways shift before a rear wheel sank into the ditch
A concealed pouch in the abandoned wagon held 7 local silver, an iron key, a Rāvik trade note, and a brass wagon-wheel token
The trade note named Orren Vask and listed a delivery to Dāren Ford
Evidence suggested a rectangular chest or lockbox had been removed from hooks beneath the wagon and later moved from a nearby brush-side spot
Orren Vask's fate remains unknown

features.name: West Road Creek Ford
known_facts: Narrow creek crossing the west road through a shallow stone ford
Clear moving water over flat rock
Approximately ankle-deep on foot at the observed crossing
Shade nearby suitable for a short roadside rest
Mårék's group took an approximately one-hour short rest here around midday on westbound journey day 1

features.name: Dāren Road Marker
known_facts: Stacked-stone roadside marker with an iron plate
Rāvik directional marking confirms the road continues toward Dāren Ford
Lower line reports the next water at roughly one day
Carries a travel / safe-stop / water symbol
No side road was observed at the marker

features.name: Smoke-farm access track
known_facts: Faint access track leaves the main road on the right when traveling west
It is not a proper regional road
Compass direction of the track is not established

features.name: Roadside Farmstead
known_facts: Small inhabited farmstead reached by the faint access track
Two main buildings, a smaller shed, fenced livestock pen, two-wheel cart, woodpile, and chimney smoke were observed
The farmers were cautious but friendly and provided road information
Mårék and Aren later returned and slept in the barn loft
A recovered branded Vārdak was left with the farmers to seek its owner; any reward was theirs
The recovered shortbow was left neatly at the farmhouse for the farmers

features.name: Hidden wagon-rut turnoff
known_facts: Fresh wagon rut veered hard left off the main road when traveling west
No return track was initially visible
The rut led into a shallow grassy hollow hidden behind a crest
Compass direction of the turnoff is not established

features.name: Thieves' Wagon Hollow
known_facts: Shallow grassy hollow screened from the road by a low crest
A small plain wagon and three men were found here
The iron-banded chest missing from Orren Vask's wagon was recovered here
Two of the three thieves died; one wounded man surrendered and was released alive
A branded draft Vārdak and additional stolen property were recovered here

features.name: Split Boulder
known_facts: Broad stone split nearly down the middle into two slabs
Marks the narrow track leading to the old broken-roof stone stash shed
No signpost was present

features.name: Broken-roof Stash Shed
known_facts: Old stone shed with part of the roof collapsed inward and a crooked wooden door
Recent boot traffic and carried / dragged-load marks showed current use
Kerr surrendered here after being convinced he was surrounded
Multiple caches of stolen goods, silver, papers, victim effects, and Rask's more private hidden material were found
A concealed meeting note points to Dāren Ford's south ferry yard after sunset and says to ask for Meln
The precise compass side of the shed track from the main road is not established

features.name: Current West-road Position
known_facts: Farther west than the split-boulder stash shed on westbound journey day 2
No proper crossroads or directional signs were observed on the current stretch before this point
An eastbound freight wagon was encountered earlier on this stretch and reported the road ahead
Current paused scene: a loose saddled Drāv stands ahead in the road with one rein dragging
The loose Drāv repeatedly looks toward the right-side ditch; no rider is yet visible

terrain_zones.name: Kareth shelf
terrain_zones.description: Relatively level usable ground; not a tight valley or enclosed basin

terrain_zones.name: Southwest stony upland
terrain_zones.description: Ground becomes progressively rockier and more elevated toward the quarry

terrain_zones.name: Northeast rolling corridor
terrain_zones.description: Avelin occupies the near portion; low rolling hills become more pronounced toward Saddle Ridge and the old Avelin route continues beyond

terrain_zones.name: Valek west-road country
terrain_zones.description: Broad low rises and shallow dips with short grass, scrub, scattered hardy trees, occasional fenced fields and distant farms, pale exposed stone on higher ground, shallow drainage cuts, and darker vegetation belts following wetter ground. Open sky; no nearby mountains were visible during the current westbound journey.
